title: App bar search
summary: A search field for a shell's header row: a pill that fills the space it is given, results in a panel below it; an icon button that expands over the header row below the phone breakpoint or with compact. The host supplies items and reads pk-query and pk-select.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the field and the expand button.

props.name: debounce
props.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before raising pk-query.

props.name: compact
props.description: Icon button at any width; expands over the header row.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the field covers the header row (phone breakpoint, or compact).

props.name: items
props.description: Results: { id, label, group?, sub?, thumbnail?, badge? }[]. Adjacent items with the same group share a heading; the host sets the order. An item with no id is a note (a group's "+12 more"): shown, never selectable. The host clears items while the query is too short.

props.name: resultsLabel
props.description: The word announced after the count to assistive technology ("5 results"); set it to localise. The no-results text is the empty slot.

props.name: error
props.description: A failed search: while set, the open results panel shows this message instead of the no-results message, so a failure never reads as nothing found. Set it when your search throws (for example "Search is unavailable. Try again.") and clear it with the next result.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: An action pinned to the bottom of the results panel (a Full search link). Hidden when empty.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: The message shown when items is empty and the field has text.

events.name: pk-query
events.description: The field's text, debounce milliseconds after the last keystroke. The host fetches or filters and sets items in response; this element never searches itself.

events.name: pk-select
events.description: A result was chosen (click or Enter). The host decides what happens; this element does not navigate.

events.name: pk-submit
events.description: Enter was pressed with a non-empty query and no result highlighted: the host shows a full results page or submits a form. This element never navigates.

events.name: pk-toggle
events.description: expanded changed by itself (the expand or collapse button, Escape, the shell's drawer opening, a navigation). Not raised for a change the host made.

parts.name: expand
parts.description: The icon button (phone breakpoint, or compact).

parts.name: control
parts.description: The field: a pk-input (type search) laid into the pill with no box of its own. Its search icon is exported as box-icon.

parts.name: status
parts.description: A visually hidden polite live region announcing the result count.

parts.name: thumb
parts.description: A result's thumbnail (dynamic; shown when the item has one).

parts.name: badge
parts.description: A result's badge text (dynamic; shown when the item has one).

parts.name: expand-icon
parts.description: The expand button's icon (the icon part of its pk-button, exported).

parts.name: collapse-icon
parts.description: The close button's icon (the icon part of its pk-button, exported).

parts.name: row
parts.description: A result row's label and subtitle column (dynamic).

parts.name: row-sub
parts.description: A result's subtitle text (dynamic; shown when the item has one).

cssProperties.name: --pk-app-bar-search-align
cssProperties.description: The field's inline margin in a flex row such as the shell header: auto centres it in the free space between the nav toggle and the actions; 0 auto keeps it at the start and auto 0 pushes it to the end. Not applied to the icon button (compact, or a phone).

cssProperties.name: --pk-app-bar-search-radius
cssProperties.description: Corner radius of the field; var(--radius-pill) for a pill.

cssProperties.name: --pk-app-bar-search-popup-width
cssProperties.description: Minimum width of the results panel, which may be wider than the field (never wider than the viewport).

a11y: ARIA 1.2 combobox with aria-activedescendant (focus stays on the input). The input is a pk-input in this element's shadow tree and the results are in this one, so aria-controls and aria-activedescendant are set as element references (pk-input listbox; Chrome 135, Safari 16.4, Firefox 136: in an older browser they do nothing, the role, name and expanded state still apply). The highlighted result is the one option with aria-selected="true". Arrow keys move, Enter picks, Escape closes the results, then collapses the field. The buttons are 44px touch targets. Enter with no highlighted result raises pk-submit. A visually hidden polite live region announces the result count after each update.
mobile: Below the phone breakpoint (or with compact) the field is an icon button that expands over the header row; on a wider screen the field is centred in the free space of the header row.
